## NIST’s AI Risk Management Framework and Its Generative-AI Profile

NIST’s AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) 1.0, released in January 2023, is a voluntary framework intended to help organizations incorporate trustworthiness considerations across the design, development, use, and evaluation of AI.

In July 2024, NIST published AI 600-1, a cross-sector profile focused on generative AI. It serves as a more specific companion to the broader framework.

The documents address different scopes: the AI RMF covers AI broadly, while AI 600-1 focuses on generative AI. They are complementary, not interchangeable.
